_schema: qec_twin.code_status.v1 — hand-maintained status overlay for tools/gen_code_map.py. Keys = package paths relative to src/ (fully-qualified, e.g. 'qec_twin/forward', 'error_coupling_simulator/source'), or a module path for a per-module override. status in {ACTIVE, PLACEHOLDER, ARCHIVED, TOOLING}. gen_code_map.py DRIFT-CHECKS this against the code: add an entry when a new package appears, remove one when a package is deleted (both are flagged in CODE_MAP.md's DRIFT CHECK). '_'-prefixed keys are config, not packages.

_local_index._note: Curated CLUSTERS of load-bearing LOCAL-ONLY working code under gitignored outputs/ (NOT committed; present on the build workstation). Maintain the GLOBS (stable); gen_code_map auto-discovers the FILES matching them, so new nm_*/cert_*/quantum_bath_* appear without editing this. Globs are relative to the repo root. NOTE: source/ + oracles/ have been re-homed into src/error_coupling_simulator/ (MIGRATION P1); the outputs/teacher_prereg/ copies below are FROZEN LEGACY — the package is canonical.

qec_twin.note: package root — numerics.NUMERICAL_ZERO floor + package glue

qec_twin/audit.note: evaluator-side gating (identifiability) / bands (uncertainty) / validity (curve) + bayes_floor decoding-floor oracle + certify

qec_twin/calibration.note: [RECOVER] label-free exact Born-NLL calibration; consumes observations ONLY (isolation contract) — the LEARNER path, must NOT import the teacher/simulator

qec_twin/decoder.note: frozen-MWPM DEM substrate (evaluator-side; DEM/decoder/LER stays OUT of the validity chain — feedback-simulator-not-decoder)

qec_twin/forward.note: exact differentiable forward: cptp_channel + channels + window_channel + joint_lindbladian (Axis-1 assembler, G2-certified). MIGRATION target: -> error_coupling_simulator/carrier (P2)

qec_twin/forward/exact.note: density-matrix backend — FEASIBILITY-ONLY (<=~15q); the 50+q target is forward/scalable

qec_twin/forward/scalable.note: the 50+q CARRIER (no longer a placeholder): C1 composed (DEM/HMM bulk + window-exact CPTP + declared seam) + non-Pauli leakage MCWF-on-MPS; ADR 0008/0010

qec_twin/hardware.note: R2-lite real-Google ingestion + M1-M4 drivers; observations-only isolation; needs QEC_TWIN_HW_DATA=/home/cx/Document

qec_twin/knobs.note: [MANIPULATE] channel-level do() -> DeltaLER (parameterization-independent transforms, scored under a frozen decoder)

qec_twin/mechanisms.note: mechanism defs + controlled teachers: catalog, axis1_primitives, source_coupling/source_process (Axis-2 memory-ful source + Theta fan-out), coupled_teachers (CoupledCycleTeacher, 2026-07-03), qutrit/seam teachers. MIGRATION target: -> error_coupling_simulator/{source,mechanisms,teachers} (P3/P5)

qec_twin/rag.note: hybrid vector-keyword store over the docs/papers reading notes (NoteStore, build_index, query); infrastructure, NOT twin logic

qec_twin/simulator.note: user-facing frontend: CircuitIR/CodeSpec/XZZX compiler, Stim import, sealed SubstepSchedule, .b8 record sampling; + the axis1 carrier-execution paths (dense joint-L probe / MCWF-MPS / QT-MPS / qutip-cuquantum) and the axis1_record_evidence dense {det,obs} emitter. MIGRATION target: -> error_coupling_simulator/frontend (P5)

error_coupling_simulator.note: NEW standalone releasable package (MIGRATION in progress, docs/error_coupling_simulator_MIGRATION.md). Consolidates the coupling-error simulator from qec_twin + gitignored outputs/. No physical ground truth — teachers = specified noise models, oracles = FORMAL bug-catchers.

error_coupling_simulator/source.note: Axis-2 source layer: P1 = nonmarkovian/divisibility/wedge (low-level RTN/1f + RHP/BLP + coherence-wedge); P3 = process (productionized SourceTimeline) + coupling (Theta fan-out). Later cleanup: reconcile process<->nonmarkovian into one coherent API.

error_coupling_simulator/mechanisms.note: P3-landed: mechanism primitives + controlled teachers — catalog, axis1_primitives (leaf), qutrit_teachers, seam_teachers. Old qec_twin.mechanisms.* are SHIMS. seam_teachers still imports qec_twin.mechanisms.teachers cross-package (teachers.py not yet moved).

error_coupling_simulator/oracles.note: P1-landed: independent QuTiP-derived {H,c} channel primitives (single_qubit/two_qubit/leakage/opensystem) — evaluator-only FORMAL oracles

error_coupling_simulator/carrier.note: P2-landing: forward propagation. joint_lindbladian (Axis-1 assembler) + cptp_channel + channels moved here; the old qec_twin.forward.{joint_lindbladian,cptp_channel,channels} are re-export SHIMS. accel/kernels (CUDA) still to move.

error_coupling_simulator/carrier/exact.note: P2: exact DM backend (feasibility-only <=~15q). qutrit_dm + circuit_sim moved here; old qec_twin.forward.exact.{qutrit_dm,circuit_sim} are SHIMS. rep_code/xzzx_parser land with frontend/mechanisms phases.

error_coupling_simulator/carrier/kernels.note: P2-COMPLETE: fused CUDA/C++ kernels (.cu/.cpp + loaders). accel + kernels moved here (they stay siblings so accel._kernels_dir() resolves); old qec_twin.forward.{accel,kernels} are SHIMS (kernels shim sys.modules-aliases the loader submodules). Compile-verified: test_kernels_fused_kraus/vmap pass from here. Needs the aiqec env bin on PATH so torch finds ninja.

error_coupling_simulator/certify.note: P4-landed: the teacher-certification seam (record schema, ControlledTeacher protocol, certify_cells scoring, Anchor/Control ports). Old qec_twin.audit.certify is a shim package (sys.modules-aliases the submodules). Only qutrit_dm dep (-> ...carrier.exact); no learner consumer. The decoder + R2 hardware stay in qec_twin (NOT moved).

error_coupling_simulator/certify/anchors.note: P4: independent-ground-truth anchor ports (DM-oracle / stim-clifford / closed-form / controls) — anti-circular referees.
